You’ll make things happen–fast.
   

  

**Role Description**
 Own the strategy, roadmap, architecture, and delivery of the SAP S/4HANA Finance platform, with prima ry responsibility for Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Asset Accounting, Banking, and Financial Reporting. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Engineering, and Enterprise Technology teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and efficient solutions. Serve as a senior product and solution leader who translates business priorities into technology outcomes while advancing AI\-enabled Finance capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the SAP Finance product vision, roadmap, backlog, prioritization, and investment recommen dations across RTR and PTP.
* Lead requirements, process design, solution architecture, and delivery for SAP S/4HANA Finance, including GL, AP, Asset Accounting, Banking, financial close, reporting, and PTP capabilities.

* Lead agile delivery teams, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure effective testing, deployment, documentation, and support.

* Present roadmaps, solution options, risks, and investment proposals to executive stakeholders.
* Stay current on SAP, Finance, integration, automation, and SaaS transformation trends and champion best\-in\-class solutions.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience architecting and delivering SAP Finance solutions, including 5\+ years with SAP S/4HANA.
* Deep experience with SAP FI, including GL, AP, Asset Accounting, Banking, Financial Reporting, financial close, and RTR/PTP processes.
* Hands\-on experience with Asset Accounting configuration and end\-to\-end processes, including acquisition, capitalization, depreciation, transfers, retirement, impairment, and financial integration.
* Experience with Thomson Reuters OneSource Tax integration with SAP, including tax determination, transaction data flows, tax posting, field mappings, and issue resolution.
* Experience defining enterprise architecture, business capability maps, current\-to\-future\-state roadmaps, and integration strategies.
* Proven experience leading agile teams, managing product backlogs, partnering with business stake holders, and overseeing vendors or implementation partners.
* Strong executive communication, solution design, troubleshooting, governance, and Finance controls experience.
* Demonstrated ability to identify practical AI, automation, or data\-driven opportunities that improve Finance productivity and quality.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAP Certification in Finance or a related SAP discipline.
* Experience with Accounts Receivable, SAP BRIM, FICA, Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), or subscription\-based Finance processes.
* Experience in high\-tech, SaaS, software, or Finance transformation programs.
* CPA, MBA, or equivalent Finance/accounting credential.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP, AI platforms, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic frameworks, or low\-code/no\-code development.
* Experience implementing responsible AI governance, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, or AI\-enabled Finance solutions

jobs.description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for an experienced SAP ISU DM (Device Management) professional to join our Utilities practice as a Senior Consultant / Lead. The ideal candidate will have strong end\-to\-end implementation and support experience in SAP IS\-Utilities with a specialization in Device Management, and should be capable of leading a module independently, mentoring junior consultants, and engaging directly with client stakeholders.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP ISU Device Management (DM) processes including device installation, removal, replacement, and device history tracking.
 



 • Handle end\-to\-end configuration of Technical Master Data — Connection Objects, Premises, Installations, Devices, Device Categories, Register Groups, and Rate Types.
 



 • Work extensively on Meter Reading (MR) processes — MR order creation, upload/download of meter reading results, plausibility checks, and MR unit configuration.
 



 • Manage Device Management integration with Billing, Invoicing, and Move\-In/Move\-Out (MIMO) processes.
 



 • Configure and support AMI/Smart Metering integration (IDEX, EDM/MDUS) where applicable.
 



 • Lead requirement gathering workshops with business/client stakeholders, prepare Functional Specifications (FS) and Business Blueprint documents.
 



 • Coordinate with ABAP/technical teams for enhancements, RFCs, BAPIs, user exits, and custom developments related to DM.
 



 • Drive integration testing, UAT, cutover, and data migration activities for Device Management objects.
 



 • Provide production support, root cause analysis, and resolution for DM\-related incidents (P1/P2 issues).
 



 • Mentor and guide junior consultants; review deliverables for quality and adherence to best practices.
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional SAP ISU teams (FICA, Billing, EDM, CRM) for end\-to\-end process alignment.
 



 • Prepare and maintain functional documentation, test scripts, and training material.
 



  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 • 8\-10 years of overall SAP experience, with a minimum of 6\-7 years dedicated to SAP ISU Device Management.
 



 • Minimum of 2\-3 full lifecycle implementations (design to go\-live) in SAP ISU DM, along with rollout/support project experience.
 



 • Strong hands\-on expertise in:
 



 o Technical Master Data (Connection Object, Premise, Installation, Device)
 



 o Meter Reading process configuration and MR order management
 



 o Device installation/removal/replacement workflows
 



 o Register groups, rate types, and profile management
 



 o Integration between DM, Billing, and Invoicing
 



 • Working knowledge of SAP FICA and SAP EDM/Billing module integration points.
 



 • Exposure to Smart Metering / AMI integration (IDEX, third\-party MDM systems) is a strong plus.
 



 • Good understanding of ABAP debugging, user exits, BAdIs, and interface architecture (functional\-level, not core development).
 



 • Experience in leading data migration/cutover activities for DM objects.
 



 • Prior experience working with utility companies (Electricity, Gas, or Water) is highly preferred.
 



 • Strong client\-facing skills — requirement gathering, workshops, stakeholder management.
 



 • Experience in S/4HANA Utilities (C4U) is an added advantage.
 



  





 Educational Qualification
 



 • B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical, or related discipline.
 



 • SAP ISU certification is preferred but not mandatory.

**Job Description**  

HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build **HPE Networking**, with the ambition of creating the **best networking business on the planet**. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program**, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a **single platform**, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.


As part of a fast\-moving, **multi\-year transformation**, the team will stabilize near\-term operations, **migrate core** **platforms, onboard****businesses****and suppliers globally**, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with**business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.


For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help**build a new business unit from its earliest days**, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership**, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

* Manage a cross\-functional delivery team spanning HPE business and IT stakeholders, system integrator partners, and onshore/offshore development and testing resources.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, and resourcing, including forecast versus actuals, change control, and clear trade\-off recommendations when priorities shift.
